issues.legal_issue: An appeal by a firm does not abate when partners joined only as formal parties die during the appeal and their legal representatives are not substituted, if the firm remains the tenant against whom relief is sought and continues the appeal.
material_facts: The landlord treated the firm as the tenant and sought eviction from the firm.
The partners were joined as proper parties, and no relief was sought against them in their personal capacities.
Two partners died while the firm’s appeal was pending, and their legal representatives were not substituted.
The firm remained a party and continued prosecuting the appeal.
issues.conclusion: The appeal did not abate. The order holding that it had abated was set aside, and the matter was remitted for decision on the merits.
issues.legal_principle: Order XXX, Rule 4 of the Code of Civil Procedure provides that, notwithstanding Section 45 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872, when persons are sued in the name of a firm, it is not necessary to join the legal representatives of a deceased person as a party. Where the firm is the tenant and the partners are only proper or formal parties, with no personal relief claimed against them, the death of a partner does not affect the proceeding if the firm remains and prosecutes it. Order XXX, Rule 1 permits a firm to be sued in its firm name. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: appeal_from_eviction_decree and firm_named_as_tenant and deceased_partners_only_formal_parties and no_personal_relief_sought_against_deceased_partners and firm_continues_prosecuting_appeal and legal_representatives_not_substituted

predicates.appeal_from_eviction_decree: The proceeding is an appeal from a decree in an eviction suit against a firm.
predicates.firm_named_as_tenant: The claimant identified the firm as the tenant from whom relief was sought.
predicates.deceased_partners_only_formal_parties: Partners of the firm were joined only as proper or formal parties.
predicates.no_personal_relief_sought_against_deceas: The claimant sought no relief against the deceased partners in their personal capacities.
predicates.firm_continues_prosecuting_appeal: The firm remained a party and continued to prosecute the appeal after the partners died.
predicates.legal_representatives_not_substituted: The legal representatives of the deceased partners were not added to the proceeding.

issues.definition: When an eviction appeal concerns a firm identified as tenant, and deceased partners were only formal parties while the firm continues the appeal, the appeal does not abate merely because their legal representatives were not substituted.
